tool_args.title: Agent Capabilities Overview
tool_args.content: Hello! I am your Taskmaster Autonomous Agent Engine. I am fully operational and ready to assist you with complex workflows. My core capabilities include: 1. Content Creation (Docs, Sheets, Gmail), 2. Project Management (Jira), 3. Web Automation (Browser Controller), 4. Media Control (YouTube, Spotify), 5. Data Processing (Extraction, DB Operations), 6. Scheduling (Google Calendar), and 7. System Integration (Webhooks). Please provide a specific goal or project you would like me to execute.
